summary: Backend-only verification of the persistent 'New Client Preview' sandbox + Coach Kai removal. 20/20 pytest cases pass. New endpoints (/coach/preview/persistent, /coach/preview/reset, /coach/preview/sandbox-info) work as spec'd: persistent is idempotent (same sandbox id across calls, same across reset), reset wipes sandbox data (workouts_count -> 0, onboarded -> False), and the user row + id + email remain stable. /coach/dashboard now returns a preview_sandbox summary with name='New Client Preview' and email='preview@crewfit.test', and the sandbox is filtered out of the main clients list. /admin/coaches lists Louis Hall and the legacy coach row renamed to 'Legacy Coach (archived)' with status='archived'; no coach with 'Kai' in the name exists. AuthZ works: client role gets 403 on all 3 sandbox endpoints. Regression flows (preview/new-client, preview/impersonate, preview/demo-seed, coach/clients, coach/dashboard) all return 200. Real client (client@crewfit.com) data is untouched by a sandbox reset.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_preview_sandbox.py:181 — safety guard correctly refuses to reset if email != 'preview@crewfit.test' or is_preview_sandbox is falsy (returns 400). Cannot be triggered via HTTP since lookup is by SANDBOX_EMAIL, but the defence-in-depth check is correct.
server.py:6976 — seed correctly force-renames the legacy Coach Kai row to 'Legacy Coach (archived)' and sets status='archived' on every startup (idempotent).

server.py:6022,6031 — 'preview_sandbox' status is now excluded from /coach/clients and /coach/dashboard client list, and surfaced via a dedicated preview_sandbox field. Clean separation confirmed by test.

feature_preview_sandbox.py RESET_COLLECTIONS is an explicit allow-list — safer than a broad wipe; consider adding 'workout_generation_jobs' if such collection exists (currently only gen_jobs/roster_jobs are listed).

feature_preview_sandbox.py:170 — using ResetBody as default (ResetBody()) as a FastAPI dependency default value is unusual; verified it still accepts a POST with {"confirm": true} body. Works but noted for future refactor.
seed_data_creation: None — reused the auto-seeded Louis + legacy coach + real client rows. Sandbox user is created lazily by the persistent endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All persistent sandbox endpoints (POST /api/coach/preview/persistent, POST /api/coach/preview/reset, GET /api/coach/preview/sandbox-info) verified. Legacy Coach Kai removal is in effect. Regression suite in /app/backend/tests/test_iter69_preview_sandbox.py is reusable for future iterations. If future work exposes a way for the sandbox user to change email or is_preview_sandbox flag, add a negative test hitting reset when those fields are tampered.
